result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline Requirements v2.8

disclosed_matters.summary: SSL.com disclosed three separate incidents involving improper certificate issuance: one wildcard certificate without proper CAA records, 57 misissued certificates from misconfigured Subordinate CA, and 11 certificates issued with unvalidated domains.

SSL.com disclosed two OCSP-related incidents: four OV TLS Subordinate CAs not configured to provide OCSP responses, and serving 'unknown' OCSP responses for over 50,000 DV TLS certificates and precertificates.
SSL.com disclosed that one EV TLS test web page had no valid certificate.
SSL.com disclosed that 247 TLS certificates, one S/MIME, one Code Signing, and two Document Signing certificates were issued using previously reported compromised keys.
